description: Open the protected contact/terms/Confirm card only after company choice. Pass the explicitly chosen company's option_key from current service_options; omit it only for a single option or a previously selected company. When a live card is displayed, omit prose or use at most one short neutral sentence: use only assistant_message in the customer's language (English: "Details and current status are in the card."). End the reply there. Do not add an introduction, summary, instructions to review or confirm, or claims that a booking is created or not yet created: this text remains after the card changes. Do not repeat companies, dates, times, prices, policies, booking references, status claims, comparisons or next steps outside the card. This applies only to successful card presentation; keep normal intake/choice questions and concise error or unavailable-UI guidance.

option_key.description: Exact option_key from this request's current service_options for the company explicitly chosen by the user. Never infer a choice from price or ordering.

name: render_service_request_form

assistant_message.const: Details and current status are in the card.
assistant_message.description: The only permitted optional caption for the live card. Translate to the customer's language without adding details or instructions.
